sentences.zh: 宣聖廟

translations.literal: Temple of the Sagely Proclaimed
translations.idiomatic: The Temple of the Sagely Proclaimed One

sentences.zh: 禮官參酌唐《開元禮》，定擬釋奠儀數：文宣王、兗國公、鄒國公每位籩豆各十、犧尊一、象尊一、簠簋各二、俎二、祝板各一、皆設案。

translations.literal: The ritual officials, consulting the Tang Kaiyuan Rites, fixed the proposed numbers for the libation sacrifice: for the Cultured Sagely King, the Lord of Yan, and the Lord of Zou, each was allotted ten bian and ten dou, one sacrificial wine vessel, one elephant-decorated vessel, two fu and gui, two zu, and one prayer board each, all set on tables.
translations.idiomatic: Drawing on the Tang dynasty's Kaiyuan Rites, the ritual officers laid down the prescribed offerings for the Confucian libation: Confucius as Cultured Sagely King, Yan Hui as Lord of Yan, and Mencius as Lord of Zou each received ten bian and ten dou vessels, one sacrificial wine vessel, one elephant-decorated vessel, two fu and gui grain stands, two meat boards, and one prayer tablet apiece, all arranged on dedicated tables.

sentences.zh: 七十二賢、二十一先儒，每位各籩一、豆一、爵一，兩廡各設象尊二。

translations.literal: For the seventy-two worthies and twenty-one earlier Confucians, each had one bian, one dou, and one jue; in each side hall two elephant-decorated vessels were set out.
translations.idiomatic: The seventy-two disciples and twenty-one earlier Confucians were each allotted one bian, one dou, and one jue; in each side hall stood two elephant-decorated wine vessels.

sentences.zh: 總用籩、豆各一百二十三，簠簋各六，俎六，犧尊三，象尊七，爵九十四。

translations.literal: In all there were used 123 bian and 123 dou, six fu and six gui, six zu, three sacrificial wine vessels, seven elephant-decorated vessels, and ninety-four jue.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony required 123 bian and 123 dou in total, along with six fu, six gui, six meat boards, three sacrificial wine vessels, seven elephant-decorated vessels, and ninety-four jue cups.

sentences.zh: 其尊皆有坫。

translations.literal: All the wine vessels had pedestals.
translations.idiomatic: Every wine vessel stood on its own pedestal.

sentences.zh: 罍二，洗二，篚勺各二，冪六。

translations.literal: Two lei, two wash basins, two baskets each with spoons, and six covers.
translations.idiomatic: There were two lei jars, two wash basins, two sets of basket and ladle, and six covers.

sentences.zh: 正位並從祀藉尊、罍、俎、豆席，約用三十幅，尊席用葦，俎、豆席用莞。

translations.literal: For the main seat and collateral sacrifices, mats for the wine vessels, lei, zu, and dou required about thirty panels; reed mats for the wine vessels, cattail mats for the zu and dou.
translations.idiomatic: Mats for the main and collateral offerings—covering the wine vessels, lei, meat boards, and dou—required roughly thirty panels in all: reed mats for the wine vessels, cattail mats for the meat boards and dou stands.

sentences.zh: 牲用羊、豕各三，酒二十瓶。

translations.literal: Victims were three sheep and three pigs; wine, twenty bottles.
translations.idiomatic: The sacrificial victims were three sheep and three pigs; wine was provided in twenty bottles.

sentences.zh: 禮行三獻，以祭酒、司業、博士充。

translations.literal: The rite was performed with three offerings; the Director of Sacrificial Wine, the Libationer, and the Erudites filled the roles.
translations.idiomatic: The ceremony followed the three-offering sequence, with the Director of Sacrificial Wine, the Libationer, and the Erudites serving as the offering officers.

sentences.zh: 分獻官二，讀祝官一，太官令一，捧祝官二，罍洗官一，爵洗官一，巾篚官二，禮直官十一，學生以儒服陪位。

translations.literal: Two sub-offering officials, one prayer reader, one Grand Steward, two prayer bearers, one lei-washing official, one jue-washing official, two towel-and-basket officials, eleven ritual attendants; students in scholar robes took accompanying positions.
translations.idiomatic: Two officials distributed the secondary offerings; one read the prayer; one Grand Steward of Sacrifices oversaw the kitchen; two bore the prayer tablets; one washed the lei, one washed the jue; two tended the towels and baskets; eleven ritual attendants stood by; and students in scholar's robes filled the accompanying ranks.

sentences.zh: 樂用登歌，大樂令一員，本署官充，樂工三十九人。

translations.literal: Music used the ascending hymn; one Grand Music Director, filled from his own office, and thirty-nine musicians.
translations.idiomatic: The ascending hymn was performed under one Grand Music Director drawn from the music office, with thirty-nine musicians.

sentences.zh: 迎神，三奏姑洗宮《來甯之曲》，辭曰：「上都隆化，廟堂作新。

translations.literal: To welcome the spirit, three performances of the Guxian-mode "Song of Coming Peace"; the text says: "The upper capital flourishes in transformation; the temple hall is made anew."
translations.idiomatic: To welcome the spirit, the "Song of Coming Peace" in the Guxian mode was played three times; its words run: "The upper capital flourishes in transformation; the temple hall stands renewed."

sentences.zh: 神之來格，威儀具陳。

translations.literal: The spirit comes to lodge; majesty and ritual are fully displayed.
translations.idiomatic: As the spirit descends, every mark of majesty and ritual is set forth.

sentences.zh: 穆穆凝旒，巍然聖真。

translations.literal: Solemn and still, the crown beads hang; towering is the sagely truth.
translations.idiomatic: Solemn and still beneath the hanging crown beads, the sagely presence towers in truth.

sentences.zh: 斯文伊始，群方所視。

translations.literal: This culture has just begun anew; all regions look upon it.
translations.idiomatic: This culture is renewed at its source, and all the realm looks on.

sentences.zh: 」初獻盥洗，姑洗宮《靜甯之曲》，辭曰：「偉矣素王，風猷至粹。

translations.literal: " At the first offering, hand-washing: the Guxian-mode "Song of Quiet Peace"; the text says: "Great is the Uncrowned King; his teachings and conduct are supremely pure."
translations.idiomatic: " For the first offering's ablution, the "Song of Quiet Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung; its words run: "Great is the Uncrowned King; his teachings and conduct are supremely pure."

sentences.zh: 垂二千年，斯文不墜。

translations.literal: For two thousand years his culture has not fallen.
translations.idiomatic: For two thousand years his culture has never fallen away.

sentences.zh: 涓辰維良，爰修祀事。

translations.literal: This chosen day is truly auspicious; now we undertake the sacrificial affair.
translations.idiomatic: On this chosen auspicious day we undertake the sacrificial rites.

sentences.zh: 沃盥于庭，嚴禋禮備。

translations.literal: Pouring ablution in the courtyard, the solemn sacrificial rites are complete.
translations.idiomatic: Ablution is poured in the courtyard; the solemn sacrificial rites stand complete.

sentences.zh: 」升階，南呂宮《肅甯之曲》，辭曰：「巍乎聖師，道全德隆。

translations.literal: " Ascending the steps, the Nanlü-mode "Song of Solemn Peace"; the text says: "Towering is the Sagely Master; his Way is complete and his virtue sublime."
translations.idiomatic: " On ascending the steps, the "Song of Solemn Peace" in the Nanlü mode was sung; its words run: "Towering is the Sagely Master; his Way is complete and his virtue sublime."

sentences.zh: 修明五常，垂教無窮。

translations.literal: He clarified the Five Constants and handed down teaching without end.
translations.idiomatic: He clarified the Five Constants and handed down teachings without end.

sentences.zh: 增崇儒宮，遹追遺風。

translations.literal: The Confucian temple is raised in honor; we deeply pursue the legacy wind.
translations.idiomatic: The Confucian temple is raised in honor as we deeply pursue the legacy he left behind.

sentences.zh: 嚴祀申虔，登降有容。

translations.literal: The solemn sacrifice expresses devotion; ascending and descending with proper bearing.
translations.idiomatic: The solemn sacrifice expresses our devotion; in ascent and descent all bear themselves with dignity.

sentences.zh: 」奠幣，姑洗宮《和甯之曲》，辭曰：「天生聖人，賢于堯舜。

translations.literal: " Presenting the silks, the Guxian-mode "Song of Harmonious Peace"; the text says: "Heaven gave birth to a sage, more worthy than Yao and Shun."
translations.idiomatic: " For the presentation of silks, the "Song of Harmonious Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung; its words run: "Heaven gave birth to a sage more worthy than Yao and Shun."

sentences.zh: 仰之彌高，磨而不磷。

translations.literal: Look up and he grows higher; polish him and he does not wear thin.
translations.idiomatic: The more one looks up to him, the higher he seems; the more one polishes against him, the harder he proves.

sentences.zh: 新廟告成，宮牆數仞。

translations.literal: The new temple is announced complete; the academy walls are many ren high.
translations.idiomatic: The new temple is declared complete, its academy walls rising many ren high.

sentences.zh: 遣使陳祠，斯文複振。

translations.literal: Envoys are dispatched to present the sacrifice; this culture is revived anew.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys are dispatched to present the sacrifice, and this culture is revived once more.

sentences.zh: 」降階，姑洗宮《安寧之曲》辭曰：「稟靈尼丘，垂芳闕里。

translations.literal: " Descending the steps, the Guxian-mode "Song of Tranquil Peace"; the text says: "He received his spirit at Ni Hill; his fragrance hangs over Que Village."
translations.idiomatic: " On descending the steps, the "Song of Tranquil Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung; its words run: "He received his spirit at Ni Hill; his fragrance endures in Que Village."

sentences.zh: 生民以來，孰如夫子。

translations.literal: Since the birth of the people, who is like the Master?
translations.idiomatic: Since humankind began, who has been like the Master?

sentences.zh: 新祠巋然，四方所視。

translations.literal: The new shrine stands towering; all four quarters look upon it.
translations.idiomatic: The new shrine stands towering, and all four quarters look upon it.

sentences.zh: 酹觴告成，祗循典禮。

translations.literal: Libation of the cup announces completion; we reverently follow the canonical rites.
translations.idiomatic: The libation cup is poured to announce completion as we reverently follow the canonical rites.

sentences.zh: 」兗國公酌獻，姑洗宮《輯甯之曲》，辭曰：「聖師之門，顏惟居上。

translations.literal: " The Lord of Yan pours the offering; the Guxian-mode "Song of Gathered Peace"; the text says: "At the Sagely Master's gate, Yan alone stands foremost."
translations.idiomatic: " For the Lord of Yan's offering pour, the "Song of Gathered Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung; its words run: "At the Sagely Master's gate, Yan alone stands foremost."

sentences.zh: 其殆庶幾，是宜配饗。

translations.literal: He nearly approached perfection; he is fit to share the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: He nearly reached perfection; he is fit to share the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 桓圭袞衣，有嚴儀象。

translations.literal: With the tall gui and embroidered robes, his august image is displayed.
translations.idiomatic: With the tall gui scepter and embroidered robes, his august image is displayed.

sentences.zh: 載之神祠，增光吾黨。

translations.literal: He is borne into the divine shrine, adding glory to our fellowship.
translations.idiomatic: He is borne into the divine shrine, adding glory to our fellowship.

sentences.zh: 」鄒國公酌獻，姑洗宮《泰甯之曲》，辭曰：「有周之衰，王綱既墜。

translations.literal: " The Lord of Zou pours the offering; the Guxian-mode "Song of Great Peace"; the text says: "When Zhou declined, the royal net had already fallen."
translations.idiomatic: " For the Lord of Zou's offering pour, the "Song of Great Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung; its words run: "When Zhou declined, the royal order had already collapsed."

sentences.zh: 是生真儒，宏才命世。

translations.literal: Then was born the true Confucian; his great talent was ordained for the age.
translations.idiomatic: Then was born the true Confucian, whose great talent was ordained for the age.

sentences.zh: 言而為經，醇乎仁義。

translations.literal: His words became the classics; pure in benevolence and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: His words became the classics, pure in benevolence and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 力扶聖功，同垂萬祀。

translations.literal: He strove to uphold the sage's achievement, sharing in offerings for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: He strove to uphold the sage's achievement, sharing in offerings for ten thousand generations.

sentences.zh: 」亞、終獻，姑洗宮《咸甯之曲》，辭曰：「於昭聖能，與天立極。

translations.literal: " The second and final offerings; the Guxian-mode "Song of Universal Peace"; the text says: "How bright is the sage's power, establishing the pole with Heaven."
translations.idiomatic: " For the second and final offerings, the "Song of Universal Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung; its words run: "How bright is the sage's power, establishing the cosmic pole with Heaven."

sentences.zh: 有承其流，皇仁帝德。

translations.literal: There are those who inherit his stream; imperial benevolence and sovereign virtue.
translations.idiomatic: There are those who inherit his stream—imperial benevolence and sovereign virtue.

sentences.zh: 豈伊立言，訓經王國。

translations.literal: Was it only in establishing words that he instructed the royal domain through the classics?
translations.idiomatic: Was it only in establishing words that he instructed the royal realm through the classics?

sentences.zh: 煥我文明，典祀千億。

translations.literal: He brightens our culture and civilization; canonical sacrifices for a hundred million ages.
translations.idiomatic: He brightens our culture and civilization; canonical sacrifices shall endure for a hundred million ages.

sentences.zh: 」送神，姑洗宮《來甯之曲》，辭曰：「吉蠲為饎，孔惠孔時。

translations.literal: " Sending off the spirit, the Guxian-mode "Song of Coming Peace"; the text says: "Auspicious purification makes the offering; greatly kind, greatly timely."
translations.idiomatic: " To send off the spirit, the "Song of Coming Peace" in the Guxian mode was sung again; its words run: "Auspicious purification makes the offering; greatly kind, greatly timely."

sentences.zh: 正辭嘉言，神之格思。

translations.literal: Correct words and fine phrases—the spirit comes to lodge here.
translations.idiomatic: With correct words and fine phrases, the spirit comes to lodge here.

sentences.zh: 是饗是宜，神保聿歸。

translations.literal: This is the feast, this is fitting; may the spirit's blessing now return.
translations.idiomatic: This feast is fitting; may the spirit's blessing now return.

sentences.zh: 惟時肇祀，太平極致。」

translations.literal: Only at this time do we inaugurate the sacrifice; the utmost of great peace."
translations.idiomatic: Only at this time do we inaugurate the sacrifice—the utmost of great peace."

sentences.zh: 承安二年，春丁，章宗親祀，以親王攝亞、終獻，皇族陪祀，文武群臣助奠。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chengan, on the spring ding day, Emperor Zhangzong personally sacrificed; a prince of the blood stood in for the second and final offerings, the imperial clan accompanied the sacrifice, and civil and military officials assisted in the presentation.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengan 2, on the spring ding day, Emperor Zhangzong performed the sacrifice in person; a prince of the blood stood in for the second and final offerings, members of the imperial clan accompanied the rite, and civil and military officials assisted in the presentation.

sentences.zh: 上親為贊文，舊封公者升為國公，侯者為國侯，郕伯以下皆封侯。

translations.literal: The emperor personally composed the praise text; those formerly enfeoffed as lords were raised to state lords, marquises to state marquises, and from the Earl of Cheng downward all were enfeoffed as marquises.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally composed the praise text; former lords were promoted to state lords, marquises to state marquises, and from the Earl of Cheng downward all received marquis titles.

sentences.zh: 宣宗遷汴，建廟會朝門內，歲祀如儀，宣聖、顏、孟各羊一、豕一，餘同小祀，共用羊八，無豕。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong moved the capital to Bian, a temple was built inside the Gate of Assembly; annual sacrifices followed the regulations. For the Sagely Proclaimed, Yan, and Meng, each had one sheep and one pig; the rest followed the minor sacrifice, eight sheep in all and no pigs.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong moved the capital to Bian, a temple was built inside the Gate of Assembly, and annual sacrifices followed the established regulations. Confucius, Yan Hui, and Mencius each received one sheep and one pig; the remainder followed the minor sacrifice format, eight sheep in all and no pigs.

sentences.zh: 其諸州釋奠並遵唐儀。

translations.literal: In all prefectures the libation sacrifices likewise followed Tang ritual.
translations.idiomatic: In all prefectures the Confucian libation sacrifices likewise followed Tang ritual practice.

sentences.zh: 武成王廟

translations.literal: Temple of the Martial Accomplished King
translations.idiomatic: The Temple of the Martial Accomplished King

sentences.zh: 泰和六年，詔建昭烈武成王廟于闕庭之右，麗澤門內。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Taihe, an edict ordered construction of the temple of the Illustrious Martial Accomplished King to the right of the palace courtyard, inside the Lizhe Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 6, an edict ordered the construction of the temple of the Illustrious Martial Accomplished King to the right of the palace courtyard, inside the Lizhe Gate.

sentences.zh: 其制一遵唐舊，禮三獻，官以四品官已下，儀同中祀，用二月上戊。

translations.literal: Its regulations entirely followed Tang precedent: the rite of three offerings, officials of fourth rank and below, ceremony equal to a middle sacrifice, performed on the upper wu day of the second month.
translations.idiomatic: Its regulations entirely followed Tang precedent: the three-offering rite, officials of fourth rank and below, ceremony equal to a middle sacrifice, performed on the upper wu day of the second month.

sentences.zh: 七年，完顏匡等言：「我朝創業功臣，禮宜配祀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Wanyan Kuang and others said: "The founding meritocrats of our dynasty ought by ritual to receive collateral sacrifice."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Wanyan Kuang and others said: "The founding meritocrats of our dynasty ought by ritual to receive collateral sacrifice."

sentences.zh: 」於是，以秦王宗翰同子房配武成王，而降管仲以下。

translations.literal: " Thereupon Prince of Qin Zonghan was paired with Zifang to accompany the Martial Accomplished King, while Guan Zhong and those below were demoted.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon Prince of Qin Zonghan was paired with Zifang to accompany the Martial Accomplished King, while Guan Zhong and those below were demoted.

sentences.zh: 又躋楚王宗雄、宗望、宗弼等侍武成王坐，韓信而下降立於廡。

translations.literal: Further promoted were Prince of Chu Zongxiong, Zongwang, Zongbi, and others to attend beside the Martial Accomplished King's seat; from Han Xin downward they stood in the side halls.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chu Zongxiong, Zongwang, Zongbi, and others were further promoted to attend beside the Martial Accomplished King's seat; from Han Xin downward they stood in the side halls.

sentences.zh: 又黜王猛、慕容恪等二十餘人，而增金臣遼王斜也等。

translations.literal: Wang Meng, Murong Ke, and more than twenty others were removed, while Jin officials such as Prince of Liao Xieye were added.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Meng, Murong Ke, and more than twenty others were removed, while Jin officials such as Prince of Liao Xieye were added.

sentences.zh: 其祭，武成王、宗翰、子房各羊一、豕一，餘共用羊八，無豕。

translations.literal: At the sacrifice, the Martial Accomplished King, Zonghan, and Zifang each had one sheep and one pig; the rest shared eight sheep in all, with no pigs.
translations.idiomatic: At the sacrifice, the Martial Accomplished King, Zonghan, and Zifang each received one sheep and one pig; the remainder shared eight sheep in all, with no pigs.

sentences.zh: 宣宗遷汴，餘會朝門內闕庭之右營廟如制，春秋上戊之祭仍舊。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong moved to Bian, the remainder was a temple built to the right of the palace courtyard inside the Gate of Assembly as prescribed; the spring and autumn upper-wu sacrifices continued as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong moved to Bian, a temple was built to the right of the palace courtyard inside the Gate of Assembly as prescribed; the spring and autumn upper-wu sacrifices continued as before.

sentences.zh: 諸前代帝王

translations.literal: Former Dynasties' Emperors
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices to Emperors of Former Dynasties

sentences.zh: 三年一祭，于仲春之月祭伏犧于陳州，神農於亳州，軒轅於坊州，少昊於兗州，顓頊於開州，高辛於歸德府，陶唐於平陽府，虞舜、夏禹、成湯於河中府，周文王、武王於京兆府。

translations.literal: Sacrificed once every three years: in the middle spring month Fuxi was sacrificed to at Chen Prefecture, Shennong at Bozhou, Xuanyuan at Fang Prefecture, Shaohao at Yan Prefecture, Zhuanxu at Kai Prefecture, Gaoxin at Guide Prefecture, Taotang Yao at Pingyang Prefecture, Yu Shun, Xia Yu, and Cheng Tang at Hezhong Prefecture, and King Wen and King Wu of Zhou at Jingzhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices were held once every three years: in mid-spring Fuxi was honored at Chen Prefecture, Shennong at Bozhou, the Yellow Emperor at Fang Prefecture, Shaohao at Yan Prefecture, Zhuanxu at Kai Prefecture, Gaoxin at Guide Prefecture, Emperor Yao at Pingyang Prefecture, Shun, Yu, and Tang at Hezhong Prefecture, and Kings Wen and Wu of Zhou at Jingzhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 泰和三年、尚書省奏：「太常寺言：'《開元禮》祭帝嚳、堯、舜、禹、湯、文、武、漢祖祝版請禦署。

translations.literal: In the third year of Taihe the Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices states: 'The Kaiyuan Rites require imperial endorsement on prayer boards for sacrifices to Di Ku, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Wen, Wu, and the Han Founder.'"
translations.idiomatic: In Taihe 3 the Secretariat memorialized: "The Court of Imperial Sacrifices reports that under the Kaiyuan Rites, prayer boards for sacrifices to Di Ku, Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Kings Wen and Wu, and the Han Founder require imperial endorsement."

sentences.zh: 《開寶禮》犧、軒、顓頊、帝嚳、陶唐、女媧、成湯、文、武請禦署，自漢高祖以下二十七帝不署。

translations.literal: The Kaibao Rites require imperial endorsement for Fu Xi, Xuanyuan, Zhuanxu, Di Ku, Taotang Yao, Nüwa, Cheng Tang, Wen, and Wu; from Han Gaozu downward twenty-seven emperors are not endorsed.
translations.idiomatic: The Kaibao Rites require imperial endorsement for Fu Xi, the Yellow Emperor, Zhuanxu, Di Ku, Emperor Yao, Nüwa, Tang, and Kings Wen and Wu; from Han Gaozu downward twenty-seven emperors are not endorsed.

sentences.zh: '平章政事鎰、左丞匡、太常博士溫蒂罕天興言：'方嶽之神各有所主，有國所賴，請禦署固宜。

translations.literal: ' Grand Councilor Yi, Left Vice Director Kuang, and Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wentihaan Tianxing said: 'The spirits of the regional mountains each have their domain; the state relies upon them—requesting imperial endorsement is certainly fitting.'
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Yi, Left Vice Director Kuang, and Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Wentihaan Tianxing said: "The spirits of the regional mountains each have their domain, and the state relies upon them—requesting imperial endorsement is certainly fitting."

sentences.zh: 至於前古帝王，寥落杳茫，列於中祀亦已厚矣，不須禦署。

translations.literal: As for the ancient emperors of former ages, remote and indistinct, to rank them among middle sacrifices is already generous; imperial endorsement is not required.
translations.idiomatic: As for the ancient emperors of former ages, remote and indistinct, ranking them among middle sacrifices is already generous; imperial endorsement is not required.

sentences.zh: '參知政事即康及鉉以為三皇、五帝、禹、湯、文、武皆垂世立教之君，唐、宋致祭皆禦署，而今降祝版不署，恐於禮未盡。

translations.literal: ' Vice Grand Councilors Jikang and Quan held that the Three August Ones, Five Emperors, Yu, Tang, Wen, and Wu were all rulers who handed down teaching for the ages; Tang and Song sacrifices all received imperial endorsement, and now to issue prayer boards without endorsement may fall short of ritual propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councilors Jikang and Quan held that the Three August Ones, Five Emperors, Yu, Tang, and Kings Wen and Wu were all rulers who handed down teaching for the ages; Tang and Song sacrifices all received imperial endorsement, and now to issue prayer boards without endorsement may fall short of ritual propriety.

sentences.zh: 不若止從外路祭社稷及釋奠文宣王例，不降祝版，而令學士院定撰祝文，頒各處為常制。

translations.literal: It would be better simply to follow the precedent of sacrifices to Earth and Grain and the libation to the Cultured Sagely King in the outer circuits—do not issue prayer boards, but have the Academy of Scholar-Officials compose the prayer texts and distribute them to each place as standing regulations.
translations.idiomatic: It would be better simply to follow the precedent of sacrifices to the Gods of Earth and Grain and the Confucian libation in the outer circuits—do not issue prayer boards, but have the Academy of Scholar-Officials compose the prayer texts and distribute them to each place as standing regulations.

sentences.zh: 」敕命依期降祝板，而不請署。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered that prayer boards be issued on schedule, but without requesting endorsement.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that prayer boards be issued on schedule, but without requesting imperial endorsement.

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·長白山

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Changbai Mountain
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Changbai Mountain

sentences.zh: 大定十二年，有司言：「長白山在興王之地，禮合尊崇，議封爵，建廟宇。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Dading, the responsible offices said: "Changbai Mountain lies in the land where the dynasty rose; by ritual it should be honored—discuss enfeoffment and the building of a temple."
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 12, the responsible offices said: "Changbai Mountain lies in the land where the dynasty rose; by ritual it should be honored—we should discuss enfeoffment and the building of a temple."

sentences.zh: 」十二月，禮部、太常、學士院奏奉敕旨封興國靈應王，即其山北地建廟宇。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month, the Ministry of Rites, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the Academy of Scholar-Officials memorialized that by imperial edict he was enfeoffed as King of the Spirit Response Who Establishes the State, and a temple was built on the north side of the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Ministry of Rites, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and the Academy of Scholar-Officials memorialized that by imperial edict the spirit was enfeoffed as King of the Spirit Response Who Establishes the State, and a temple was built on the north side of the mountain.

sentences.zh: 十五年三月，奏定封冊儀物，冠九旒，服九章，玉圭、玉冊、函、香、幣、冊、祝。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fifteenth year they memorialized to fix the enfeoffment regalia: a crown with nine tassels, robes with nine emblems, jade gui, jade book, case, incense, silks, book, and prayer.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fifteenth year they memorialized to fix the enfeoffment regalia: a crown with nine tassels, robes with nine emblems, a jade gui, jade book, case, incense, silks, book, and prayer.

sentences.zh: 遣使副各一員，詣會寧府。

translations.literal: One envoy and one deputy were dispatched to Huining Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: One envoy and one deputy were dispatched to Huining Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 行禮官散齋二日，致齋一日。

translations.literal: The ritual officials observed two days of dispersed abstinence and one day of concentrated abstinence.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials observed two days of dispersed abstinence and one day of concentrated abstinence.

sentences.zh: 所司於廟中陳設如儀。

translations.literal: The responsible offices set out the arrangements in the temple according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices set out the arrangements in the temple according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 廟門外設玉冊、袞冕幄次，牙杖旗鼓從物等視一品儀。

translations.literal: Outside the temple gate pavilions were set for the jade book and embroidered robes; ivory staffs, banners, drums, and accompanying objects followed first-rank ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the temple gate pavilions were set for the jade book and embroidered robes; ivory staffs, banners, drums, and accompanying objects followed first-rank ceremony.

sentences.zh: 禮用三獻，如祭嶽鎮。

translations.literal: The rite used three offerings, as in sacrifices to mountain and city gods.
translations.idiomatic: The rite used three offerings, as in sacrifices to mountain and city gods.

sentences.zh: 其冊文雲：「皇帝若曰：自兩儀剖判，山嶽神秀各鐘於其分野。

translations.literal: The text of the book reads: "The emperor says: Since the two principles were divided, the divine excellence of mountains and peaks each gathered in its allotted domain."
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffment text reads: "The emperor says: Since heaven and earth were divided, the divine excellence of mountains and peaks each gathered in its allotted domain."

sentences.zh: 國將興者，天實作之。

translations.literal: When a state is about to rise, Heaven truly makes it so.
translations.idiomatic: When a state is about to rise, Heaven truly makes it so.

sentences.zh: 對越神休，必以祀事。

translations.literal: To respond to the spirits' blessing, sacrifice is indispensable.
translations.idiomatic: To respond to the spirits' blessing, sacrifice is indispensable.

sentences.zh: 故肇基王跡，有若岐陽。

translations.literal: Therefore at the founding of the royal footprints it was as at Qiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore at the founding of the royal footprints it was as at Qiyang.

sentences.zh: 望秩山川，于稽虞《典》。

translations.literal: To gaze upon and rank the mountains and rivers accords with the Canon of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: To gaze upon and rank the mountains and rivers accords with the Canon of Yu.

sentences.zh: 厥惟長白，載我金德，仰止其高，實惟我舊邦之鎮。

translations.literal: This Changbai bears our Jin virtue; looking up to its height, it is truly the guardian of our old domain.
translations.idiomatic: This Changbai bears our Jin virtue; looking up to its height, it is truly the guardian of our old domain.

sentences.zh: 混同流光，源所從出。

translations.literal: The Hun Tong flows with light—the source from which we sprang.
translations.idiomatic: The Hun Tong flows with light—the source from which we sprang.

sentences.zh: 秩秩幽幽，有相之道。

translations.literal: Orderly and deep, there is a way of assisting.
translations.idiomatic: Orderly and deep, there is a way of assisting.

sentences.zh: 列聖蕃衍熾昌，迄于太祖，神武征應，無敵於天下，爰作神主。

translations.literal: The successive sages multiplied and flourished brightly, reaching the Grand Ancestor, whose divine martial power responded in conquest, unmatched under Heaven—thus he became the divine sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: The successive sages multiplied and flourished brightly, reaching the Grand Ancestor, whose divine martial power responded in conquest, unmatched under Heaven—thus he became the divine sovereign.

sentences.zh: 肆予沖人，紹休聖緒，四海之內，名山大川，靡不鹹秩。

translations.literal: Now I, a young ruler, inherit the sage's glorious succession; within the four seas, famous mountains and great rivers—none are not all ranked in order.
translations.idiomatic: Now I, a young ruler, inherit the sage's glorious succession; within the four seas, famous mountains and great rivers—none fail to receive their proper rank.

sentences.zh: 矧王業所因，瞻彼旱麓，可儉其禮？

translations.literal: How much more the foundation of royal enterprise—gazing upon that dry hillside, can its rites be made sparing?
translations.idiomatic: How much more the foundation of royal enterprise—gazing upon that dry hillside, can its rites be made sparing?

sentences.zh: 服章爵號非位於公侯之上，不足以稱焉。

translations.literal: Robes, emblems, and titles of rank not placed above lords and marquises are insufficient to do it honor.
translations.idiomatic: Robes, emblems, and titles of rank not placed above lords and marquises are insufficient to do it honor.

sentences.zh: 今遣某官某，持節備物，冊命茲山之神為興國靈應王，仍敕有司歲時奉祀，於戲！

translations.literal: Now we dispatch a certain official, bearing credentials and complete regalia, to enfeoff the spirit of this mountain as King of the Spirit Response Who Establishes the State, and further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices—alas!
translations.idiomatic: Now we dispatch a certain official, bearing credentials and complete regalia, to enfeoff the spirit of this mountain as King of the Spirit Response Who Establishes the State, and further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices—alas!

sentences.zh: 廟食之享，亙萬億年。

translations.literal: Temple offerings and feasts for a hundred million years without end.
translations.idiomatic: Temple offerings and feasts shall endure for a hundred million years without end.

sentences.zh: 維金之禎，與山無極，豈不偉歟？

translations.literal: May Jin's good fortune be boundless with the mountain—is it not magnificent?
translations.idiomatic: May Jin's good fortune be boundless with the mountain—is it not magnificent?

sentences.zh: 」自是，每歲降香，命有司春秋二仲擇日致祭。

translations.literal: " From this time forth, incense was sent down each year, and the responsible offices were commanded to choose days in the second months of spring and autumn to perform the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: From this time forth, incense was sent down each year, and the responsible offices were commanded to choose days in the second months of spring and autumn to perform the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 明昌四年十月，備袞冕、玉冊、儀物，上禦大安殿，用黃麾立仗八百人，行仗五百人，複冊為開天弘聖帝。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Mingchang, embroidered robes, jade book, and ritual objects were prepared; the emperor attended the Great Peace Hall, with eight hundred men standing guard under yellow banners and five hundred in procession; he was again enfeoffed as Emperor Who Opens Heaven and Magnifies Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Mingchang 4, embroidered robes, a jade book, and ritual objects were prepared; the emperor attended the Great Peace Hall, with eight hundred men standing guard under yellow banners and five hundred in procession; the spirit was again enfeoffed as Emperor Who Opens Heaven and Magnifies Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·大房山

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Dafang Mountain
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Dafang Mountain

sentences.zh: 大定二十一年，敕封山陵地大房山神為保陵公，冕八旒、服七章、圭、冊、香、幣，使副持節行禮，並如冊長白山之儀。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Dading, by edict the spirit of Dafang Mountain at the imperial tombs was enfeoffed as Lord Who Protects the Tombs, with an eight-tassel crown, seven-emblem robes, gui, book, incense, and silks; envoy and deputy bore credentials to perform the rite, all as in the enfeoffment of Changbai Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 21, by edict the spirit of Dafang Mountain at the imperial tombs was enfeoffed as Lord Who Protects the Tombs, with an eight-tassel crown, seven-emblem robes, a gui, book, incense, and silks; envoy and deputy bore credentials to perform the rite, all as in the enfeoffment of Changbai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 其冊文雲：「皇帝若曰：古之建邦設都，必有名山大川以為形勝。

translations.literal: The text of the book reads: "The emperor says: In ancient times when states were founded and capitals established, there had to be famous mountains and great rivers as strategic terrain."
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffment text reads: "The emperor says: In ancient times when states were founded and capitals established, there had to be famous mountains and great rivers as strategic terrain."

sentences.zh: 我國既定鼎于燕，西顧郊圻，巍然大房，秀撥混厚，雲雨之所出，萬民之所瞻，祖宗陵寢於是焉依。

translations.literal: Our state having established the tripod at Yan, looking west to the suburban domain, towering is Dafang, its excellence drawn from the deep and thick, whence clouds and rain issue, upon which the myriad people gaze, and where the ancestral tombs rely.
translations.idiomatic: Our state having established the capital at Yan, looking west to the suburban domain, towering stands Dafang, its excellence drawn from the deep and thick, whence clouds and rain issue, upon which the myriad people gaze, and where the ancestral tombs rely.

sentences.zh: 仰惟岳鎮古有秩序，皆載祀典，矧茲大房，禮可闕歟？

translations.literal: Looking up, the mountain and city gods of old had their order, all recorded in the sacrificial canon—how much more this Dafang; can its rites be omitted?
translations.idiomatic: Looking up, the mountain and city gods of old had their order, all recorded in the sacrificial canon—how much more this Dafang; can its rites be omitted?

sentences.zh: 其爵號服章俾列于侯伯之上，庶足以稱。

translations.literal: His title, robes, and emblems should be ranked above marquises and earls, that it may suffice to do him honor.
translations.idiomatic: His title, robes, and emblems should be ranked above marquises and earls, that it may suffice to do him honor.

sentences.zh: 今遣某官某，備物冊命神為保陵公。

translations.literal: Now we dispatch a certain official, with complete regalia to enfeoff the spirit as Lord Who Protects the Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: Now we dispatch a certain official, with complete regalia to enfeoff the spirit as Lord Who Protects the Tombs.

sentences.zh: 申敕有司，歲時奉祀。

translations.literal: We further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: We further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 其封域之內，禁無得樵采弋獵。

translations.literal: Within his enfeoffed domain, cutting firewood, gathering, hunting, and fowling are forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Within his enfeoffed domain, cutting firewood, gathering, hunting, and fowling are forbidden.

sentences.zh: 著為令。

translations.literal: This was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: This was established as a regulation.

sentences.zh: 」是後，遣使山陵行禮畢，山陵官以一獻禮致奠。

translations.literal: " Thereafter, when the envoy's rites at the imperial tombs were completed, the tomb officials performed presentation with the single-offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, when the envoy's rites at the imperial tombs were completed, the tomb officials performed presentation with the single-offering rite.

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·混同江

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Hun Tong River
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Hun Tong River

sentences.zh: 大定二十五年，有司言：「昔太祖征遼，策馬徑渡，江神助順，靈應昭著，宜修祠宇，加賜封爵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Dading, the responsible offices said: "In former days when the Grand Ancestor campaigned against Liao, he spurred his horse straight across; the river god aided his cause, and the spiritual response was manifest—a shrine should be repaired and enfeoffment bestowed."
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 25, the responsible offices said: "In former days when the Grand Ancestor campaigned against Liao, he spurred his horse straight across; the river god aided his cause, and the spiritual response was manifest—a shrine should be repaired and enfeoffment bestowed."

sentences.zh: 」乃封神為興國應聖公，致祭如長白山儀，冊禮如保陵公故事。

translations.literal: " The spirit was then enfeoffed as Duke of the Sagely Response Who Establishes the State; sacrifices followed the Changbai Mountain rite, and the enfeoffment ceremony followed the precedent of the Lord Who Protects the Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit was then enfeoffed as Duke of the Sagely Response Who Establishes the State; sacrifices followed the Changbai Mountain rite, and the enfeoffment ceremony followed the precedent of the Lord Who Protects the Tombs.

sentences.zh: 其冊文雲：「昔我太祖武元皇帝，受天明命，掃遼季荒茀，成師以出，至於大江，浩浩洪流，不舟而濟，雖穆滿渡江面黿粱，光武濟河而水冰，自今觀之無足言矣！

translations.literal: The text of the book reads: "In former days our Grand Ancestor, the Martial Origin Emperor, received Heaven's bright mandate, swept away the Liao dynasty's wild wasteland, and led his army forth to the great river—a vast torrent, yet he crossed without boats. Though King Mu of Zhou crossed the river on a turtle bridge and Emperor Guangwu crossed the Yellow River on ice, viewed from today these are hardly worth mentioning!"
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffment text reads: "In former days our Grand Ancestor, the Martial Origin Emperor, received Heaven's bright mandate, swept away the Liao dynasty's wild wasteland, and led his army forth to the great river—a vast torrent, yet he crossed without boats. Though King Mu of Zhou crossed the river on a turtle bridge and Emperor Guangwu crossed the Yellow River on ice, viewed from today these are hardly worth mentioning!"

sentences.zh: 執徐之歲，四月孟夏，朕時邁舊邦，臨江永歎，仰藝祖之開基，佳江神之效靈，至止上都，議所以尊崇之典。

translations.literal: In the year of Zhixu, in the first month of summer in the fourth month, I then journeyed to the old domain, stood by the river and sighed long, looked up to the founding ancestor's establishment of the base, and admired the river god's manifestation of spirit; arriving at the Upper Capital, I discussed the regulations by which to honor him.
translations.idiomatic: In the year of Zhixu, in early summer of the fourth month, I journeyed to the old domain, stood by the river and sighed long, looked up to the founding ancestor's establishment of the realm, and admired the river god's manifestation of spirit; arriving at the Upper Capital, I discussed the regulations by which to honor him.

sentences.zh: 蓋古者五嶽視三公，四瀆視諸侯，至有唐以來，遂享帝王之尊稱，非直後世彌文，而崇德報功理亦有當然者。

translations.literal: For in antiquity the Five Peaks were regarded as equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and the Four Watercourses as equal to feudal lords; from the Tang onward they came to enjoy the exalted titles of emperors and kings—not merely later ages adding ornament, for honoring virtue and repaying merit has its proper rationale.
translations.idiomatic: For in antiquity the Five Peaks were regarded as equal to the Three Ducal Ministers, and the Four Watercourses as equal to feudal lords; from the Tang onward they came to enjoy the exalted titles of emperors and kings—not merely later ages adding ornament, for honoring virtue and repaying merit has its proper rationale.

sentences.zh: 矧茲江源出於長白，經營帝鄉，實相興運，非錫以上公之號，則無以昭答神休。

translations.literal: How much more this river, whose source issues from Changbai, passes through the imperial domain, and truly shares in the dynasty's rise—unless bestowed the title of upper duke, there is no way to manifest response to the spirit's blessing.
translations.idiomatic: How much more this river, whose source issues from Changbai, passes through the imperial domain, and truly shares in the dynasty's rise—unless bestowed the title of upper duke, there is no way to manifest response to the spirit's blessing.

sentences.zh: 今遣某官某。

translations.literal: Now we dispatch a certain official.
translations.idiomatic: Now we dispatch a certain official.

sentences.zh: 持節備物冊命神為興國應聖公。

translations.literal: Bearing credentials and complete regalia to enfeoff the spirit as Duke of the Sagely Response Who Establishes the State.
translations.idiomatic: Bearing credentials and complete regalia to enfeoff the spirit as Duke of the Sagely Response Who Establishes the State.

sentences.zh: 申命有司，歲時奉祀。

translations.literal: We further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: We further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 嚴廟貌，正封爵，禮亦至矣！

translations.literal: The temple appearance is made solemn, the enfeoffment is made correct—the ritual has reached its fullness!
translations.idiomatic: The temple appearance is made solemn, the enfeoffment is made correct—the ritual has reached its fullness!

sentences.zh: 惟神其衍靈長之德，用輔我國家彌億年，神亦享廟食於無窮，豈不休哉！」

translations.literal: May the spirit extend its long-lasting spiritual virtue to assist our state for a hundred million years; may the spirit also enjoy temple offerings without end—is it not glorious!"
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit extend its long-lasting spiritual virtue to assist our state for a hundred million years; may the spirit also enjoy temple offerings without end—is it not glorious!"

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·嘉廕侯

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Marquis of Fine Shade
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Marquis of Fine Shade

sentences.zh: 大定二十五年，敕封上京護國林神為護國嘉廕侯，毳冕七旒，服五章，圭同信圭，遣使詣廟，以三獻禮祭告。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Dading, by edict the spirit of the Upper Capital's forest that protects the state was enfeoffed as Marquis of Fine Shade Who Protects the State, with a fur crown of seven tassels, robes of five emblems, and a gui like the trust gui; an envoy was sent to the temple to announce the sacrifice with the three-offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 25, by edict the spirit of the Upper Capital's forest that protects the state was enfeoffed as Marquis of Fine Shade Who Protects the State, with a fur crown of seven tassels, robes of five emblems, and a gui like the trust gui; an envoy was sent to the temple to announce the sacrifice with the three-offering rite.

sentences.zh: 其祝文曰：「蔚彼長林，實壯於邑，廣袤百里，惟神主之。

translations.literal: The prayer text says: "Luxuriant is that long forest, truly strengthening the settlement; a hundred li in breadth, the spirit alone is its lord."
translations.idiomatic: The prayer text says: "Luxuriant is that long forest, truly strengthening the settlement; a hundred li in breadth, the spirit alone is its lord."

sentences.zh: 廟貌有嚴，侯封是享，歆時蠲潔，相厥滋榮。

translations.literal: The temple appearance is solemn; the marquis's enfeoffment is enjoyed; at the appointed time pure offerings are received, assisting its flourishing growth.
translations.idiomatic: The temple appearance is solemn; the marquis's enfeoffment is enjoyed; at the appointed time pure offerings are received, assisting its flourishing growth.

sentences.zh: 」是後，遇月七日，上京幕官一員行香，著為令。

translations.literal: " Thereafter, on the seventh day of each month one Upper Capital bureau official offered incense; this was established as a regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, on the seventh day of each month one Upper Capital bureau official offered incense; this was established as a regulation.

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·瀘溝河神

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Spirit of the Lugou River
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Spirit of the Lugou River

sentences.zh: 大定十九年，有司言：「瀘溝河水勢泛決齧民田，乞官為封冊神號。

translations.idiomatic: Subsequently, by special decree he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Tranquil Peace and a temple was built.

translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, by imperial command, each year the local prefectural chief was charged with spring and autumn sacrifices, as regulated.

translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Sagely Consort of Manifest Response and Smooth Aid

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Dading, the Directorate of Waterways said: "The temple of the Yellow River's Sagely Consort at Yangwu Upper Embankment should follow the Tang precedent of sacrificing to the Five Dragon Shrine in mid-spring."
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 17, the Directorate of Waterways said: "The temple of the Yellow River's Sagely Consort at Yangwu Upper Embankment should follow the Tang precedent of sacrificing to the Five Dragon Shrine in mid-spring."

translations.literal: " In the first month of spring in the twenty-seventh year, the Secretariat said: "The Sagely Consort temple in Heyin County, Zheng Prefecture—in former ages when the river brought disaster, prayers repeatedly received response, and titles and temple inscriptions were once added."

sentences.zh: 今因禱祈，河遂安流，乞加褒贈。

sentences.zh: 廟曰靈德善利之廟。

translations.literal: The temple was named the Temple of Spiritual Virtue and Beneficent Profit.
translations.idiomatic: The temple was named the Temple of Spiritual Virtue and Beneficent Profit.

translations.idiomatic: Each year the local prefectural chief was charged with spring and autumn sacrifices, as regulated.

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Duke Who Pacifies the Realm
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Duke Who Pacifies the Realm

sentences.zh: 舊名旺國崖，太祖伐遼嘗駐蹕於此。

translations.literal: Its former name was Wangguo Cliff; when the Grand Ancestor campaigned against Liao he once halted his carriage here.
translations.idiomatic: Its former name was Wangguo Cliff; when the Grand Ancestor campaigned against Liao he once halted his carriage here.

sentences.zh: 大定八年五月，更名靜寧山，後建廟。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year of Dading it was renamed Tranquil Peace Mountain, and a temple was later built.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Dading 8 it was renamed Tranquil Peace Mountain, and a temple was later built.

sentences.zh: 明昌六年八月，以冕服玉冊，冊山神為鎮安公。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixth year of Mingchang, with crown robes and jade book, the mountain spirit was enfeoffed as Duke Who Pacifies the Realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Mingchang 6, with crown robes and jade book, the mountain spirit was enfeoffed as Duke Who Pacifies the Realm.

sentences.zh: 冊文曰：「皇帝若曰：古之名山，鹹在祀典。

translations.literal: The text of the book reads: "The emperor says: The famous mountains of antiquity were all in the sacrificial canon."
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffment text reads: "The emperor says: The famous mountains of antiquity were all in the sacrificial canon."

sentences.zh: 軒皇之世，神靈所奉者七千。

translations.literal: In the age of the Yellow Emperor, seven thousand were received in spirit worship.
translations.idiomatic: In the age of the Yellow Emperor, seven thousand were received in spirit worship.

sentences.zh: 虞氏之時，望秩每及於五載。

translations.literal: In the time of the House of Yu, gazing upon and ranking them came every five years.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of the House of Yu, gazing upon and ranking them came every five years.

sentences.zh: 蓋惟有益於國，是以必報其功。

translations.literal: For only what benefits the state must its merit be repaid.
translations.idiomatic: For only what benefits the state must its merit be repaid.

sentences.zh: 逮乎後王，申以徽冊，至於嶽鎮之外，亦或封爵之加。

translations.literal: Down to later kings, splendid books were extended; beyond the mountain and city gods, enfeoffment was sometimes also added.
translations.idiomatic: Down to later kings, splendid books were extended; beyond the mountain and city gods, enfeoffment was sometimes also added.

sentences.zh: 故太白有神應之稱，而終南有廣惠之號。

translations.literal: Thus Taibai received the title of Spirit Response, and Zhongnan the designation of Broad Beneficence.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Taibai received the title of Spirit Response, and Zhongnan the designation of Broad Beneficence.

sentences.zh: 禮由義起，事與時偕，載籍所傳，於今猶監，朕修和有夏，咸秩無文，眷茲靜寧，秀峙朔野，厓澤布氣，幽贊乎坤元，導風出雲，協符乎乾造。

translations.literal: Rites arise from righteousness; affairs keep pace with the times—what the records transmit we still take as mirror. I cultivate harmony like the Xia; all ranks are without omission. Fond is this Tranquil Peace, towering splendid in the northern wilds; its cliffs and marshes spread qi, secretly assisting the earthly principle, guiding wind and issuing clouds, in accord with the heavenly creation.
translations.idiomatic: Rites arise from righteousness; affairs keep pace with the times—what the records transmit we still take as mirror. sentences.zh: 一方之表，萬物所瞻，南直都畿，北維障徼，連延廣厚，寶藏攸興，盤固高明，謻宮斯奠。

translations.literal: The marker of one region, upon which the myriad things gaze; south it faces the capital domain, north it buttresses the frontier barrier; continuous, vast, and thick, treasures rise from it; firm, lofty, and bright, the secluded palace is here established.
translations.idiomatic: The marker of one region, upon which the myriad things gaze; south it faces the capital domain, north it buttresses the frontier barrier; continuous, vast, and thick, treasures rise from it; firm, lofty, and bright, the secluded palace is here established.

sentences.zh: 昔有遼嘗恃以富國，迄大定更為之錫名。

translations.literal: Formerly Liao once relied upon it to enrich the state; down to Dading it was again granted a bestowed name.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Liao once relied upon it to enrich the state; down to Dading it was again granted a bestowed name.

sentences.zh: 洪惟世宗，功昭列聖，亦越顯考，德利生民。

translations.literal: Great was Emperor Shizong, his merit manifest to the successive sages; also surpassing was my illustrious father, whose virtue benefited the living people.
translations.idiomatic: Great was Emperor Shizong, his merit manifest to the successive sages; also surpassing was my illustrious father, whose virtue benefited the living people.

sentences.zh: 爰即歲時，駕言臨幸，兵革不試，遠人輯寧。

translations.literal: Then at the appointed season he drove forth to visit in person; weapons were not tested, and distant peoples were gathered in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Then at the appointed season he drove forth to visit in person; weapons were not tested, and distant peoples were gathered in peace.

sentences.zh: 雨暘常調，品匯蕃廡，此上帝無疆之貺，亦英靈有相之符。

translations.literal: Rain and sunshine were constantly in harmony; all kinds flourished abundantly—this was the Supreme Lord's boundless gift, and also the sign of the heroic spirit's assistance.
translations.idiomatic: Rain and sunshine were constantly in harmony; all kinds flourished abundantly—this was the Supreme Lord's boundless gift, and also the sign of the heroic spirit's assistance.

sentences.zh: 比即輿情，載修故事。

translations.literal: Now matching public sentiment, we again repair the old precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Now matching public sentiment, we again repair the old precedent.

sentences.zh: 顧先皇帝駐蹕之地，揖累世承平之風。

translations.literal: Looking back to where the former emperor halted his carriage, we bow to the wind of peace handed down through successive generations.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back to where the former emperor halted his carriage, we bow to the wind of peace handed down through successive generations.

sentences.zh: 迓續遺休，式甄神祐，肆象德以畀號，仍班台而闡儀。

translations.literal: Welcoming the continuation of the legacy blessing, we thereby discern the spirit's aid; we extend the emblem of virtue to bestow a title, and still distribute the altar to unfold the rites.
translations.idiomatic: Welcoming the continuation of the legacy blessing, we thereby discern the spirit's aid; we extend the emblem of virtue to bestow a title, and still distribute the altar to unfold the rites.

sentences.zh: 宇像一新，采章具舉。

translations.literal: The temple images are made new; emblems and ornaments are fully displayed.
translations.idiomatic: The temple images are made new; emblems and ornaments are fully displayed.

sentences.zh: 今遣使某、副某，持節備物，冊命神為鎮安公，仍敕歲時奉祀。

translations.literal: Now we dispatch envoy so-and-so and deputy so-and-so, bearing credentials and complete regalia, to enfeoff the spirit as Duke Who Pacifies the Realm, and further command seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Now we dispatch envoy so-and-so and deputy so-and-so, bearing credentials and complete regalia, to enfeoff the spirit as Duke Who Pacifies the Realm, and further command seasonal sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 於戲！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 容典焜燿，精明感通，惟永億年，翊我昌運。

translations.literal: May the ceremonial splendor shine bright, spirit and clarity sense and connect—for ten thousand million years may it assist our flourishing fortune.
translations.idiomatic: May the ceremonial splendor shine bright, spirit and clarity sense and connect—for ten thousand million years may it assist our flourishing fortune.

sentences.zh: 神其受職，豈不偉歟？」

translations.literal: May the spirit receive its charge—is it not magnificent?"
translations.idiomatic: May the spirit receive its charge—is it not magnificent?"

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·瑞聖公

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Duke of Auspicious Sageliness
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Duke of Auspicious Sageliness

sentences.zh: 即麻達葛山也，章宗生於此。

translations.literal: This is Madage Mountain; Emperor Zhangzong was born here.
translations.idiomatic: This is Madage Mountain; Emperor Zhangzong was born here.

sentences.zh: 世宗愛此山勢衍氣清，故命章宗名之。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong loved this mountain's spreading terrain and clear qi, and therefore had Zhangzong name it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong loved this mountain's spreading terrain and clear qi, and therefore had Zhangzong name it.

sentences.zh: 後更名胡土白山，建廟。

translations.literal: Later it was renamed Hutubai Mountain and a temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was renamed Hutubai Mountain and a temple was built.

sentences.zh: 明昌四年八月，以冕服玉冊，封山神為瑞聖公。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year of Mingchang, with crown robes and jade book, the mountain spirit was enfeoffed as Duke of Auspicious Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Mingchang 4, with crown robes and jade book, the mountain spirit was enfeoffed as Duke of Auspicious Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 建廟，命撫州有司，春秋二仲，擇日致祭為常。

translations.literal: A temple was built; the responsible offices of Fuzhou were commanded that in the second months of spring and autumn they choose days for sacrifice as the regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: A temple was built; the responsible offices of Fuzhou were commanded that in the second months of spring and autumn they choose days for sacrifice as the regular practice.

sentences.zh: 其冊文曰：「皇帝若曰：國家之興，命曆攸屬。

translations.literal: The text of the book reads: "The emperor says: When a state rises, the mandate and calendar belong to it."
translations.idiomatic: The enfeoffment text reads: "The emperor says: When a state rises, the mandate and calendar belong to it."

sentences.zh: 天地元化，惟時合符。

translations.literal: Heaven and earth's primal transformation accords with the time in perfect correspondence.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and earth's primal transformation accords with the time in perfect correspondence.

sentences.zh: 山川百神，無不受職。

translations.literal: Mountains, rivers, and the hundred spirits—none fail to receive their charge.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains, rivers, and the hundred spirits—none fail to receive their charge.

sentences.zh: 粹精薦瑞，明聖繼生。

translations.literal: Pure essence presents auspicious omens; the bright sage succeeds in birth.
translations.idiomatic: Pure essence presents auspicious omens; the bright sage succeeds in birth.

sentences.zh: 著丕應於殊禎，啟昌期於幽贊。

translations.literal: Manifesting great response in extraordinary blessings, opening a flourishing age through hidden assistance.
translations.idiomatic: Manifesting great response in extraordinary blessings, opening a flourishing age through hidden assistance.

sentences.zh: 裒對信猶之典，咸修望秩之文。

translations.literal: Gathering the canon of trust and response, all repair the texts of gazing upon and ranking.
translations.idiomatic: Gathering the canon of trust and response, all repair the texts of gazing upon and ranking.

sentences.zh: 嘉乃名山，奠茲勝地，下綿乾分，上直樞輝。

translations.literal: Praising this famous mountain, establishing this excellent site—below it extends the heavenly allotment, above it faces the pivot's radiance.
translations.idiomatic: Praising this famous mountain, establishing this excellent site—below it extends the heavenly allotment, above it faces the pivot's radiance.

sentences.zh: 盤析木之津，達中原之氣。

translations.literal: Coiling at the ford of the Wood Star, it reaches the qi of the Central Plain.
translations.idiomatic: Coiling at the ford of the Wood Star, it reaches the qi of the Central Plain.

sentences.zh: 廓除氛昆，函毓泰和。

translations.literal: Sweeping away miasma and turbidity, it embraces and nurtures great harmony.
translations.idiomatic: Sweeping away miasma and turbidity, it embraces and nurtures great harmony.

sentences.zh: 仰惟光烈昭垂，徽音如在，即高明而清暑，克靜壽以安仁。

translations.literal: Looking up, the bright merit shines down; the fine reputation is as if present—approaching the lofty and bright to clear summer heat, achieving tranquil longevity and peaceful benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up, the bright merit shines down; the fine reputation is as if present—approaching the lofty and bright to clear summer heat, achieving tranquil longevity and peaceful benevolence.

sentences.zh: 周廬安寧，厚澤浹洽。

translations.literal: The surrounding lodges are tranquil; thick favor permeates all.
translations.idiomatic: The surrounding lodges are tranquil; thick favor permeates all.

sentences.zh: 朕祗循祖武，順講時巡，感美號以興懷，佩聖謨而介福。

translations.literal: I reverently follow the ancestors' martial way, comply with the seasonal tour, am moved by the fine title to stir the heart, and wear the sage's counsel to receive blessing.
translations.idiomatic: I reverently follow the ancestors' martial way, comply with the seasonal tour, am moved by the fine title to stir the heart, and wear the sage's counsel to receive blessing.

sentences.zh: 言念誕彌之初度，言由翊衛之效靈。

translations.literal: Speaking, I recall the first anniversary of birth; speaking, it comes from the assisting guard's manifestation of spirit.
translations.idiomatic: Speaking, I recall the first anniversary of birth; speaking, it comes from the assisting guard's manifestation of spirit.

sentences.zh: 然猶祀秩無章，神居不屋，非所以盡報功崇德之義，副追始樂原之心。

translations.literal: Yet still the sacrificial rank lacks regulation, the spirit dwells without a house—this is not the way to fulfill the meaning of repaying merit and honoring virtue, nor to match the heart that pursues the beginning and delights in the origin.
translations.idiomatic: Yet still the sacrificial rank lacks regulation, the spirit dwells without a house—this is not the way to fulfill the meaning of repaying merit and honoring virtue, nor to match the heart that pursues the beginning and delights in the origin.

sentences.zh: 爰飾名稱，載新祠宇。

translations.literal: Therefore we adorn the title and renew the shrine.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we adorn the title and renew the shrine.

sentences.zh: 勒忱辭於貞琰，涓良日於元龜，彰服采以辨威，潔庪縣而致祭。

translations.literal: We inscribe sincere words on the steadfast tablet, select an auspicious day from the primal tortoise, display robes and emblems to distinguish majesty, and purify the spirit table to perform the sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: We inscribe sincere words on the steadfast tablet, select an auspicious day from the primal tortoise, display robes and emblems to distinguish majesty, and purify the spirit table to perform the sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 闡揚茂實，敷繹多儀。

translations.literal: We expound flourishing substance and unfold the many rites.
translations.idiomatic: We expound flourishing substance and unfold the many rites.

sentences.zh: 今遣使某、副某，持節備物，冊命神為瑞聖公，仍敕有司歲時奉祀。

translations.literal: Now we dispatch envoy so-and-so and deputy so-and-so, bearing credentials and complete regalia, to enfeoff the spirit as Duke of Auspicious Sageliness, and further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Now we dispatch envoy so-and-so and deputy so-and-so, bearing credentials and complete regalia, to enfeoff the spirit as Duke of Auspicious Sageliness, and further command the responsible offices to offer seasonal sacrifices.

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 尚其聰明，歆此誠意，孚休惟永，亦莫不寧。」
