translations.idiomatic: May it be intelligent and perceptive, receive this sincere intent; may blessing and rest be everlasting—all will be at peace."

sentences.zh: 諸神雜祠·貞獻郡王廟

translations.literal: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Temple of the Loyal Offering Prince of the Commandery
translations.idiomatic: Miscellaneous Shrines to Various Spirits: Temple of the Loyal Offering Prince of the Commandery

sentences.zh: 明昌五年正月，陳言者謂：「葉魯、穀神二賢創制女直文字，乞各封贈名爵，建立祠廟。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year of Mingchang, a petitioner said: "The two worthies Yelu and Gushen created the Jurchen script—we beg that each be granted posthumous titles and ranks and that shrines be established."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Mingchang 5, a petitioner said: "The two worthies Yelu and Gushen created the Jurchen script—we beg that each be granted posthumous titles and ranks and that shrines be established."

sentences.zh: 令女直、漢人諸生隨拜孔子之後拜之。

translations.literal: Let Jurchen and Han students worship them after worshipping Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: Let Jurchen and Han students worship them after worshipping Confucius.

sentences.zh: 」有司謂：「葉魯難以致祭，若金源郡貞獻王穀神則既已配享太廟矣，亦難特立廟也。

translations.literal: " The responsible offices said: "Yelu is difficult to sacrifice to; as for Gushen, Loyal Offering Prince of Jinyuan Commandery, he already enjoys collateral sacrifice in the Grand Ancestral Temple—it is also difficult to establish a separate shrine."
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices said: "Yelu is difficult to sacrifice to; as for Gushen, Loyal Offering Prince of Jinyuan Commandery, he already enjoys collateral sacrifice in the Grand Ancestral Temple—it is also difficult to establish a separate shrine."

sentences.zh: 」有旨，令再議之。

translations.literal: " There was an imperial command to discuss it again.
translations.idiomatic: There was an imperial command to discuss it again.

sentences.zh: 禮官言：「前代無創制文字入孔子廟故事，如於廟後或左右置祠，令諸儒就拜，亦無害也。

translations.literal: The ritual officials said: "Former ages have no precedent of creators of script entering Confucius's temple; if shrines are placed behind or to the sides of the temple and the various scholars go to worship there, it would do no harm."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials said: "Former ages have no precedent of creators of script entering Confucius's temple; if shrines are placed behind or to the sides of the temple and the various scholars go to worship there, it would do no harm."

sentences.zh: 」尚書省謂：「若如此，恐不副國家厚功臣之意。

translations.literal: " The Secretariat said: "If it were done thus, I fear it would not match the state's intent to richly honor meritorious subjects."
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said: "If it were done thus, I fear it would not match the state's intent to richly honor meritorious subjects."

sentences.zh: 」遂詔令依蒼頡立廟於盩厔例，官為立廟於上京納裏渾莊，委本路官一員與本千戶春秋致祭，所用諸物從宜給之。

translations.literal: " An edict then ordered that following the precedent of Cangjie establishing a temple at Zhouzhi, the state should build a temple at Nali Hunzhuang in the Upper Capital, charge one official of the circuit and the local chiliarch with spring and autumn sacrifices, and supply the required objects as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then ordered that following the precedent of Cangjie establishing a temple at Zhouzhi, the state should build a temple at Nali Hunzhuang in the Upper Capital, charge one official of the circuit and the local chiliarch with spring and autumn sacrifices, and supply the required objects as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 大定四年五月，不雨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year of Dading, there was no rain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Dading 4, there was no rain.

sentences.zh: 命禮部尚書王競祈雨北嶽，以定州長貳官充亞、終獻。

translations.literal: The Minister of Rites Wang Jing was ordered to pray for rain at the Northern Peak; the chief and deputy officials of Ding Prefecture served as second and final offering officers.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Rites Wang Jing was ordered to pray for rain at the Northern Peak; the chief and deputy officials of Ding Prefecture served as second and final offering officers.

sentences.zh: 又卜日於都門北郊，望祀嶽鎮海瀆，有司行事，禮用酒脯醢。

translations.literal: A day was also divined at the northern suburb outside the capital gate for gazing sacrifices to the mountain and city gods and the seas and rivers; the responsible offices performed the rite, using wine, dried meat, and pickled meat.
translations.idiomatic: A day was also divined at the northern suburb outside the capital gate for gazing sacrifices to the mountain and city gods and the seas and rivers; the responsible offices performed the rite, using wine, dried meat, and pickled meat.

sentences.zh: 後七日不雨，祈太社、太稷。

translations.literal: After seven days with no rain, prayers were made at the Grand Altars of Earth and Grain.
translations.idiomatic: After seven days with no rain, prayers were made at the Grand Altars of Earth and Grain.

sentences.zh: 又七日祈宗廟，不雨，仍從嶽鎮海瀆如初祈。

translations.literal: After another seven days prayers were made at the ancestral temple; still no rain, and they again followed the mountain and city gods and seas and rivers as at the first prayer.
translations.idiomatic: After another seven days prayers were made at the ancestral temple; still no rain, and they again followed the mountain and city gods and seas and rivers as at the first prayer.

sentences.zh: 其設神座，實樽罍，如常儀。

translations.literal: They set out spirit seats and filled the wine vessels, as in the regular rite.
translations.idiomatic: They set out spirit seats and filled the wine vessels, as in the regular rite.

sentences.zh: 其樽罍用瓢齊，擇甘瓠去柢以為尊。

translations.literal: For the wine vessels they used gourd ladles; selecting sweet gourds, they removed the stems to make wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: For the wine vessels they used gourd ladles; selecting sweet gourds, they removed the stems to make wine vessels.

sentences.zh: 祝版惟五嶽、宗廟、社稷禦署，餘則否。

translations.literal: Prayer boards received imperial endorsement only for the Five Peaks, the ancestral temple, and Earth and Grain; for the rest, no.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer boards received imperial endorsement only for the Five Peaks, the ancestral temple, and the Gods of Earth and Grain; for the rest, no.

sentences.zh: 後十日不雨，乃徒市，禁屠殺，斷傘扇，造土龍以祈。

translations.literal: After ten more days without rain, they moved the market, forbade slaughter, stopped umbrellas and fans, and made an earthen dragon to pray.
translations.idiomatic: After ten more days without rain, they moved the market, forbade slaughter, stopped umbrellas and fans, and made an earthen dragon to pray.

sentences.zh: 雨足則報祀，送龍水中。

translations.literal: When rain was sufficient they offered the report sacrifice and sent the dragon into the water.
translations.idiomatic: When rain was sufficient they offered the report sacrifice and sent the dragon into the water.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏六月，京畿久雨，遵祈雨儀，命諸寺觀啟道場祈禱。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer in the seventeenth year, the capital region had long rain; following the rain-prayer rites, all temples and monasteries were ordered to open ritual grounds for prayer.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer in the seventeenth year, the capital region had long rain; following the rain-prayer rites, all temples and monasteries were ordered to open ritual grounds for prayer.

sentences.zh: 金因遼舊俗，以重五、中元、重九日行拜天之禮。

translations.literal: Jin followed Liao's old custom, performing the rite of worshipping Heaven on the Double Fifth, Mid-Yuan, and Double Ninth days.
translations.idiomatic: Jin followed Liao's old custom, performing the rite of worshipping Heaven on the Double Fifth, Mid-Yuan, and Double Ninth days.

sentences.zh: 重五于鞠場，中元於內殿，重九於都城外。

translations.literal: The Double Fifth at the ball ground, Mid-Yuan in the inner hall, Double Ninth outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Double Fifth at the ball ground, Mid-Yuan in the inner hall, Double Ninth outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 其制，刳木為盤，如舟狀，赤為質，畫雲鶴文。

translations.literal: The regulation was to hollow wood into a tray shaped like a boat, red as the base, painted with cloud and crane designs.
translations.idiomatic: The regulation was to hollow wood into a tray shaped like a boat, red as the base, painted with cloud and crane designs.

sentences.zh: 為架高五六尺，置盤其上，薦食物其中，聚宗族拜之。

translations.literal: A frame five or six feet high was made, the tray placed upon it, food presented within, and the clan gathered to worship.
translations.idiomatic: A frame five or six feet high was made, the tray placed upon it, food presented within, and the clan gathered to worship.

sentences.zh: 若至尊則于常武殿築台為拜天所。

translations.literal: For the sovereign, a platform was built at the Ever Martial Hall as the place for worshipping Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: For the sovereign, a platform was built at the Ever Martial Hall as the place for worshipping Heaven.

sentences.zh: 重五日質明，陳設畢，百官班俟于球場樂亭南。

translations.literal: On the Double Fifth at dawn, when the arrangements were complete, the officials lined up waiting south of the ball ground's music pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: On the Double Fifth at dawn, when the arrangements were complete, the officials lined up waiting south of the ball ground's music pavilion.

sentences.zh: 皇帝靴袍乘輦，宣徽使前導，自球場南門入，至拜天臺，降輦至褥位。

translations.literal: The emperor in boots and robe rode the palanquin, the Xuanhui Commissioner leading ahead; entering by the ball ground's south gate, he reached the Heaven-worship terrace and descended to the cushion position.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor in boots and robe rode the palanquin, the Xuanhui Commissioner leading ahead; entering by the ball ground's south gate, he reached the Heaven-worship terrace and descended to the cushion position.

sentences.zh: 皇太子以下百官皆詣褥位，宣徽贊：「拜。

translations.literal: From the crown prince downward all officials went to the cushion position; the Xuanhui Commissioner intoned: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: From the crown prince downward all officials went to the cushion position; the Xuanhui Commissioner intoned: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」皇帝再拜。

translations.literal: " The emperor bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 上香，又再拜。

translations.literal: He offered incense and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: He offered incense and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 排食拋盞畢，又再拜。

translations.literal: When arranging food and casting cups was finished, he bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: When arranging food and casting cups was finished, he bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 飲福酒，跪飲畢，又再拜。

translations.literal: He drank the blessing wine, knelt and finished drinking, and bowed twice again.
translations.idiomatic: He drank the blessing wine, knelt and finished drinking, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 百官陪拜，引皇太子以下先出，皆如前導引。

translations.literal: The officials accompanied in bowing; the crown prince and those below were led out first, all as before in the leading.
translations.idiomatic: The officials accompanied in bowing; the crown prince and those below were led out first, all as before in the procession.

sentences.zh: 皇帝回輦至幄次，更衣，行射柳、擊球之戲，亦遼俗也，金因尚之。

translations.literal: The emperor returned by palanquin to the pavilion, changed clothes, and performed the games of shooting the willow and striking the ball—also Liao custom, which Jin therefore esteemed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor returned by palanquin to the pavilion, changed clothes, and performed the games of shooting the willow and striking the ball—also Liao custom, which Jin therefore esteemed.

sentences.zh: 凡重五日拜天禮畢，插柳、球場為兩行，當射者以尊卑序，各以帕識其枝，去地約數寸，削其皮而白之。

translations.literal: Whenever the Double Fifth Heaven-worship rite was finished, willows were planted in two rows at the ball ground; those to shoot were ordered by rank, each marking his branch with a cloth, a few inches from the ground, the bark stripped to show white.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the Double Fifth Heaven-worship rite was finished, willows were planted in two rows at the ball ground; those to shoot were ordered by rank, each marking his branch with a cloth, a few inches from the ground, the bark stripped to show white.

sentences.zh: 先以一人馳馬前導，後馳馬以無羽橫鏃箭射之，既斷柳，又以手接而馳去者，為上。

translations.literal: First one man galloped ahead as guide; then another galloped and shot with a featherless transverse-arrow; whoever broke the willow and also caught it in hand while galloping away ranked highest.
translations.idiomatic: First one man galloped ahead as guide; then another galloped and shot with a featherless transverse-arrow; whoever broke the willow and also caught it in hand while galloping away ranked highest.

sentences.zh: 斷而不能接去者，次之。

translations.literal: Who broke it but could not catch it while riding away ranked next.
translations.idiomatic: Who broke it but could not catch it while riding away ranked next.

sentences.zh: 或斷其青處，及中而不能斷，與不能中者，為負。

translations.literal: Who broke only the green part, or hit but could not break, or could not hit at all, lost.
translations.idiomatic: Who broke only the green part, or hit but could not break, or could not hit at all, lost.

sentences.zh: 每射，必伐鼓以助其氣。

translations.literal: At each shot drums were necessarily struck to assist their spirit.
translations.idiomatic: At each shot drums were necessarily struck to rouse their spirit.

sentences.zh: 已而擊球，各乘所常習馬，持鞠杖。

translations.literal: Then they struck the ball, each riding the horse he usually practiced with, holding a ball club.
translations.idiomatic: Then they played ball, each riding the horse he usually practiced with, holding a ball club.

sentences.zh: 杖長數尺，其端如偃月。

translations.literal: The club was several feet long, its end like a reclining moon.
translations.idiomatic: The club was several feet long, its end shaped like a reclining moon.

sentences.zh: 分其眾為兩隊，共爭擊一球。

translations.literal: The crowd was divided into two teams, all striving to strike one ball.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd was divided into two teams, all striving to strike one ball.

sentences.zh: 先于球場南立雙桓，置板，下開一孔為門，而加網為囊，能奪得鞠擊人網囊者為勝，或曰：「兩端對立二門，互相排擊，各以出門為勝。

translations.literal: First at the south of the ball ground twin posts were set up with a board; below, one hole was opened as a gate, and a net was added as a bag—whoever could seize the ball and strike it into the net bag won; some say: "At both ends two gates face each other, each side drives and strikes, and victory goes to whoever gets the ball out the gate."
translations.idiomatic: First at the south of the ball ground twin posts were set up with a board; below, one hole was opened as a gate, and a net was added as a bag—whoever could seize the ball and strike it into the net bag won; some say: "At both ends two gates face each other, each side drives and strikes, and victory goes to whoever gets the ball out the gate."

sentences.zh: 」球狀小如拳，以輕韌木枵其中而硃之。

translations.literal: " The ball was small like a fist, made of light resilient wood hollowed within and lacquered vermilion.
translations.idiomatic: The ball was small like a fist, made of light resilient wood hollowed within and lacquered vermilion.

sentences.zh: 皆所以習蹺捷也。

translations.literal: All this was to practice agility.
translations.idiomatic: All this was to practice agility.

sentences.zh: 既畢賜宴，歲以為常。

translations.literal: When finished a banquet was granted; this became the annual custom.
translations.idiomatic: When finished a banquet was granted; this became the annual custom.

sentences.zh: 本國拜儀

translations.literal: Native-Country Bowing Rites
translations.idiomatic: Native-Country Bowing Rites

sentences.zh: 金之拜制，先袖手微俯身，稍複卻，跪左膝，左右搖肘，若舞蹈狀。

translations.literal: Jin's bowing system: first hands in sleeves, body slightly bowed, then slightly withdrawn, kneeling on the left knee, swaying elbows left and right like a dance.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's bowing system: first hands in sleeves, body slightly bowed, then slightly withdrawn, kneeling on the left knee, swaying elbows left and right like a dance.

sentences.zh: 凡跪，搖袖，下拂膝，上則至左右肩者，凡四。

translations.literal: Each kneeling: sway the sleeves, brush down to the knees, up to left and right shoulders—four times in all.
translations.idiomatic: Each kneeling: sway the sleeves, brush down to the knees, up to left and right shoulders—four times in all.

sentences.zh: 如此者四跪，複以手按右膝，單跪左膝而成禮。

translations.literal: Thus four kneelings; then pressing the right knee with the hand, kneeling only on the left knee to complete the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Thus four kneelings; then pressing the right knee with the hand, kneeling only on the left knee to complete the rite.

sentences.zh: 國言搖手而拜謂之「撒速」。

translations.literal: In the national language, bowing while swaying the hands was called "sasu."
translations.idiomatic: In the national language, bowing while swaying the hands was called "sasu."

sentences.zh: 承安五年五月，上諭旨有司曰：「女直、漢人拜數可以相從者，酌中議之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth year of Chengan, the emperor instructed the responsible offices: "Where Jurchen and Han bowing counts can follow each other, deliberate and decide a middle course."
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Chengan 5, the emperor instructed the responsible offices: "Where Jurchen and Han bowing counts can follow each other, deliberate and decide a middle course."

sentences.zh: 」禮官奏曰：「《周官》九拜，一曰稽首，拜中至重，臣拜君之禮也。

translations.literal: " The ritual officials memorialized: "The Zhou Offices' nine bows—one is kowtow, the heaviest among bows, the rite of subjects bowing to lords."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials memorialized: "The Zhou Offices' nine bows—one is kowtow, the heaviest among bows, the rite of subjects bowing to lords."

sentences.zh: 乞自今，凡公服則用漢拜，若便服則各用本俗之拜。

translations.literal: We beg that from now on, whenever in formal dress use the Han bow; in informal dress each use his own native bow.
translations.idiomatic: We beg that from now on, whenever in formal dress use the Han bow; in informal dress each use his own native bow.

sentences.zh: 」主事陳松曰：「本朝拜禮，其來久矣，乃便服之拜也。

translations.literal: " Supervisor Chen Song said: "The native-country court bow has long existed—it is the bow of informal dress."
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor Chen Song said: "The native-country court bow has long existed—it is the bow of informal dress."

sentences.zh: 可令公服則朝拜，便服則從本朝拜。

translations.literal: It may be ordered that in formal dress use the court bow, in informal dress follow the native-country bow.
translations.idiomatic: It may be ordered that in formal dress use the court bow, in informal dress follow the native-country bow.

sentences.zh: 」平章政事張萬公謂拜禮各便所習，不須改也，司空完顏襄曰：「今諸人衽發皆從本朝之制，宜從本朝拜禮，松言是也。

translations.literal: " Grand Councilor Zhang Wangong said each should use the bow convenient to what he is accustomed to and need not change; Minister of Works Wanyan Xiang said: "Now all people wear their hair according to our dynasty's regulation—they should follow the native-country court bow; Song's words are correct."
translations.idiomatic: Grand Councilor Zhang Wangong said each should use the bow convenient to what he is accustomed to and need not change; Minister of Works Wanyan Xiang said: "Now all people wear their hair according to our dynasty's regulation—they should follow the native-country court bow; Song's words are correct."

sentences.zh: 」上乃命公裳則朝拜，諸色人便服則皆用本朝拜。

translations.literal: " The emperor then ordered that in formal dress use the court bow, and all persons of every category in informal dress all use the native-country bow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered that in formal dress use the court bow, and all persons of every category in informal dress all use the native-country bow.
